0.headline: Rosewood Corporation, Motilal Oswal-backed CDMO Symbiotec Pharmalab to launch Rs 1,757-crore IPO on August 24, cuts OFS size
0.heading: Rosewood Corporation, Motilal Oswal-backed CDMO Symbiotec Pharmalab to launch Rs 1,757-crore IPO on August 24, cuts OFS size
0.intro: Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO | The company aims to raise Rs 150 crore by issuing fresh shares, while existing shareholders will be selling shares worth up to Rs 1,607 crore.
0.body:
Madhya Pradesh-based contract development and manufacturing organisation Symbiotec Pharmalab, which is backed by Rosewood Corporation, and Motilal Oswal, has decided to open its maiden public issue amounting to Rs 1,757 crore on August 24.

This would be the second mainboard IPO opening next week along side Skyways Air Services public issue.

Symbiotec aims to raise Rs 150 crore by issuing fresh shares, while existing shareholders will be selling shares worth up to Rs 1,607 crore.

Promoter Satwani Holdings LLP will be offloading Rs 144 crore worth shares, while investors Rosewood Investments and Motilal Oswal Private Equity-backed India Business Excellence Fund – III will be selling shares amounting to Rs 988 crore, and Rs 475 crore, respectively.

Rosewood Investments and India Business Excellence Fund – III are the largest shareholders in the company with 34.78 percent, and 24.16 percent stakes, respectively, while promoters had 36.4 percent shareholding as per the red herring prospectus filed on August 18.

The company has reduced its offer-for-sale size from Rs 2,030 crore while keeping the fresh issue component unchanged at Rs 150 crore planned at the time of filing of DRHP in December 2025. Capital markets regulator SEBI has approved draft papers of Symbiotec in March 2026.

The price band for the offer has been fixed at Rs 938-988 per share, valuing the company Rs 6,348.5 crore.

The one-day anchor book will be launched on August 21, while the issue will remain open for the public till August 27. The IPO share allotment is expected to get finalised by August 28, while participants are likely to start trading in Symbiotec Pharmalab shares on the stock exchanges effective September 1.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

The company has reserved Rs 3 crore worth shares for its employees. They will receive shares at a discount of Rs 90 per share to the final offer price.

Half of the net public issue size has been reserved for qualified institutional buyers, while the 35 percent shares have been allocated for retail investors, and the remaining 10 percent shares for non-institutional investors.

Symbiotec Pharmalab, the research and development-driven, science-based pharmaceutical and biotechnology company, operates as a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) for specialty pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies globally, offering products and services across the three platforms - organic chemistry, biotechnology and complex injectables. It also manufactures own products across three segments.

It claims a global leadership position in corticosteroid and steroidal-hormone active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in volume terms, with a global volume market share of 38.2 percent and 23.8 percent, respectively.

The company has two operational API manufacturing facilities with a maximum chemical synthesis capacity of 584.67 metric tonnes (MT), fermentation capacity of 300 kilolitres (KL). Further, it has commissioned two additional manufacturing facilities at Ujjain and Mhow, Madhya Pradesh, and it in the process of expanding biologics capacity by adding a proposed dedicated 14 KL fermentation capacity for biologics manufacturing in Ujjain.

Most of the net fresh issue proceeds i.e. Rs 112.5 crore will be utilised for repaying certain debt out of the total outstanding borrowings of Rs 349.7 crore as of March 2026. And the remainder funds will be set aside for general corporate purposes, while the offer-for-sale money will be received by selling shareholders.

On the financial front, Symbiotec Pharmalab has reported profit of Rs 109.9 crore for the financial year ended March 2026, growing 13.6 percent from Rs 96.8 crore in previous fiscal. Revenue soared 15.6 percent during the same period to Rs 869.1 crore from Rs 751.6 crore.

The merchant bankers managing the Symbiotec Pharmalab IPO are JM Financial, Avendus Capital, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors, and Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities (India).

1.headline: Shiprocket share price live: Stock signals bumper 32% listing gain at Rs 128
1.heading: Shiprocket share price live: Stock signals bumper 32% listing gain at Rs 128
1.intro: Behari Lal Engineering share price live: Stock jumps 35% in pre-open, signals strong listing
1.body:
Two IPOs - Shiprocket and Behari Lal Engineering - are set to make their stock market debut today, August 19, with grey market trends signalling strong listing gains for investors.

Shiprocket, which raised Rs 1,617.48 crore through its IPO, was subscribed 102.28 times during the bidding period. Its shares are scheduled to list on both the BSE and NSE today.

Shiprocket GMP signals over 34% listing gain.

Shiprocket's grey market premium (GMP) stood at Rs 33.5 per share as of August 18. With the IPO's upper price band fixed at Rs 97, the GMP indicated a potential listing price of Rs 130.50, implying a listing gain of around 34.54%.

The IPO received strong demand across investor categories. The retail portion was subscribed 48.38 times, while the QIB (ex-anchor) category was subscribed 125.20 times and the NII category 92.58 times.

However, GMP is an unofficial indicator and does not guarantee the actual listing price. The premium can change before the stock makes its debut.

Shiprocket GMP stayed above Rs 30.

Shiprocket's GMP remained in positive territory throughout the IPO period. It stood at around Rs 34 when the issue opened on August 12, rose to Rs 36.5 on August 13 and ended the three-day bidding period at around Rs 34 on August 14.

The premium subsequently slipped to around Rs 32 on August 15 and 16 before recovering to Rs 33.5 on August 17. It remained at the same level on August 18, a day before the listing.
Behari Lal Engineering GMP points to 41% premium

Behari Lal Engineering is also set to list on the BSE and NSE today, August 19. The company's IPO opened for subscription on August 12 and closed on August 17, with the allotment finalised on August 18.

The stock is commanding a grey market premium of Rs 118, according to Investorgain. At the IPO price of Rs 285, this indicates an estimated listing price of Rs 403, representing a potential gain of around 41.40%.

Expert sees constructive setup for Behari Lal Engineering.

According to Harshal Dasani, Business Head at INVasset PMS, Behari Lal Engineering comes to the market with a constructive listing setup.

Dasani said grey-market enthusiasm could support listing sentiment, but sustaining any premium would depend on how effectively the company's new capacity translates into revenue, cash flows and return ratios.

"The listing setup is supportive, but the next rerating has to come from earnings delivery," Dasani said.

Analyst advises partial profit booking.

Mahesh M Ojha, VP Research &amp; Business Development at Kantilal Chhaganlal Securities, recommended existing Behari Lal Engineering allottees consider booking partial listing gains while retaining the balance for the medium to long term, subject to post-listing price performance.

Investors will now watch the actual debut of both Shiprocket and Behari Lal Engineering to see whether their stock market listings match the strong premiums indicated by the grey market.

2.headline: Gaja Capital raises Rs 165 crore via anchor book ahead of Rs 550-crore IPO
2.heading: Gaja Capital raises Rs 165 crore via anchor book ahead of Rs 550-crore IPO
2.intro: Gaja Capital IPO | The initial public offering included fresh issuance of equity shares worth Rs 450 crore. The offer also comprises an offer-for-sale amounting to Rs 100 crore by promoters and other selling shareholders.
2.body:
Gaja Alternative Asset Management, the alternative asset management company commercially known as Gaja Capital, has raised Rs 165 crore via anchor book on August 18. This fund raising came in a day before the IPO opening for public subscription on August 19.

The company has approached capital markets with the objective to mobilise up to Rs 550 crore via initial public offering (IPO) which included fresh issuance of equity shares worth Rs 450 crore. The offer also comprises an offer-for-sale amounting to Rs 100 crore by promoters and other selling shareholders.

The price band for the offer, which closes on August 21, has been fixed at Rs 152-160 per share.

Total 15 institutional investors participated in the anchor book on Tuesday including Societe Generale, Ashish Kochalia-backed Bengal Finance and Investments, Ashwin Kumar Kothari group's Winro Commercial (India), and Mukul Agrawal-mentored Sanshi Fund-I.

The allocation of 1.03 crore equity shares has been finalised by Gaja Capital, at the upper end of price band.

Out of the total allocation, it has allocated 67.18 lakh equity shares to seven domestic mutual funds including Nippon Life India, Invesco, JM Financial MF, Groww MF, Helios Mutual Fund, Trust MF, and Samco, which have applied through a 13 schemes.

Insurance companies also showed interest in Gaja Capital as HDFC Life, SBI Life, and Bajaj Life have also decided to pick up 17.18 lakh equity shares worth Rs 27.49 crore.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Gopal Jain, Ranjit Jayant Shah, and Imran Jafar-promoted Gaja Alternative Asset Management will utilise Rs 372 crore of net fresh issue proceeds for investing towards sponsor commitments to certain existing and new funds and for repayment of the bridge loan amount. And the remaining funds will be set aside for general corporate purposes.

The company that acts as an investment manager to India focused funds - category II and category I alternative investment funds (AIFs), and advisors to offshore funds has reported profit at Rs 79.7 crore in the fiscal year ended March 2026, soaring 33.8 percent from Rs 59.5 crore in previous financial year. Its revenue increased 11.1 percent to Rs 135.5 crore from Rs 122 crore during the same period.

JM Financial, and IIFL Capital Services are acting as the merchant bankers for the Gaja Capital IPO.
